description: Agent Skills for DNA: dna-operational crafts structure/v1 and behaviour/v1; dna-sync validates and applies them to a Workspace over MCP. Install with npx skills add dna-codes/skills.
rules: Install with: npx skills add dna-codes/skills --skill dna-operational --skill dna-sync.
dna-operational drafts structure/v1 (ontology) and behaviour/v1 (actions, operations, workflows, policies). dna-sync transports finished documents with list/get then validate then apply.

Shipped authoring MCP tools only: describe, validate, apply, get, list, diff, set-egress-allowlist. set-egress-allowlist is person-only. After behaviour is applied, tools/list also exposes Action-derived business tools from that DNA. Do not call dna_search, dna_describe or dna_start.
Look-up of existing org DNA mid-task uses the separate business-rules skill, not this pack.
Docs and MCP connect: https://dna.codes/agents/ — tool contracts at https://dna.codes/agents/docs/tools.md
